flora: Mature Bull Kelp (massive, thick, leathery golden-brown fronds floating near the surface, anchored by thick ropelike stipes)
Early marine macroalgae clusters (tufted greens and delicate reds in the background)
Benthic microalgal mats coating the lower substrate
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions with a thick, tactile 'rubbery' texture for the kelp; dense, underwater marine atmosphere; suspended organic particulate filtering light beams; reflecting a cool-temperate coastal marine climate.

visual_logic.composition: An underwater wide-angle view looking slightly upward from a shallow coastal lagoon bed. Massive, wide golden-brown kelp blades dominate the upper water column, swaying with a gentle current. In the background, the soft silhouettes of other marine plants fade into the hazy, green-tinted water.
visual_logic.ground: A mix of dark greenish-grey muddy silt and sandy ocher patches, with smooth, water-worn glauconitic sandstone boulders providing anchorage for the kelp holdfasts.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright coastal sunlight filtering down through a moving, rippling ocean surface, creating dancing patterns of dappled light and volumetric sunbeams cutting through the green water column.
